{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure freshness
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

print("Unique values in revenue column:")
print(sales_df['revenue'].unique())

print("\nRows where revenue is not a valid number:")
invalid_rows = sales_df[~sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('.', '', regex=False).str.isnumeric()]
print(invalid_rows[['order_id', 'revenue']])

# Check if '0.00' is the only valid format and if there are any commas or other symbols
print("\nExamples of revenue values:")
print(sales_df['revenue'].head(10))"}
